evals.name: appends a new entry, never edits history
evals.prompt: We just decided to drop the gRPC migration after burning a week on it — sticking with REST for the internal API. Log this decision.
evals.expected_output: Appends a new sequentially-numbered DEC entry capturing the context, decision, and consequences.
assertions: The response appends a new sequentially numbered entry (DEC-NNN format).
The response does not rewrite or delete any existing entry.

evals.name: records a reversal without mutating history
evals.prompt: We reversed DEC-007: the pilot is going back to SQLite because managed Postgres is too expensive. Record that reversal without changing the old entry.
evals.expected_output: Reads DEC-007, appends DEC-008 with status superseded by DEC-007, and leaves the original text untouched.
assertions: The response appends DEC-008 rather than editing DEC-007 in place.
The new entry records DEC-007 as superseded and explains the cost-driven reversal.
The response does not delete or rewrite the existing DEC-007 text.
transcript_assertions: The transcript reads docs/decision-log.md before writing the reversal.
The final decision log contains the original DEC-007 content and a new DEC-008 entry.
